Support & FAQ

What are the watch product terms?

All 16 timepieces feature a 25-day term. Returns are credited once in full upon completion of the 25-day maturity period.

What are the recharge and withdrawal minimums?

Minimum recharge: UGX 5,000. Minimum withdrawal: UGX 5,000. Withdrawal tax: 5%.

What is the referral commission policy?

Commission is 15% of a referred member's first successful purchase only. Later purchases and registrations do not earn commission.
